title: What's the time?
description: Read clocks and compare usual activities with what people are doing today. 读钟表，并对比日常活动与今天正在进行的活动。
answer_note: The twelve clock answers are suggested readings of the pictured clocks; no audio recording was supplied. Answers to the textbook picture prompts and written exercises are suggested, not an official key. Workbook exercises A and B follow their supplied printed keys; A.4 accepts I / We and I'm not / we aren't. Grammar answers follow the Lesson 58 key on PDF viewer pages 489–490. Grammar exercise I begins on viewer page 177 and continues on page 178.

lesson.title: They usually ... but today, they are ...
lesson.instruction: Complete each contrast using the two numbered pictures and their printed sentence beginnings.
lesson.translation: 根据每组编号图片和印出的句子开头，完成“通常……，但今天……”的对比。
lesson.context: They usually ... but today, they are ... 他们通常……，但是今天他们正……。 The five pairs are numbered 13th–14th, 15th–16th, 17th–18th, 19th–20th and 21st–22nd.

questions.prompt: 13th: He usually shaves at seven o'clock every day, [picture: a man shaving beside a clock showing seven]. 14th: but today, he ... [the same man shaving beside a clock showing eight]. Complete the contrast.
questions.answer: He usually shaves at seven o'clock every day, but today, he is shaving at eight o'clock.

questions.prompt: 15th: She usually drinks tea in the morning, [picture: a woman drinking beside a rounded teapot]. 16th: but this morning, she ... [the woman drinking beside a tall coffee pot]. Complete the contrast.
questions.answer: She usually drinks tea in the morning, but this morning, she is drinking coffee.

questions.prompt: 17th: They usually play in the garden in the afternoon, [picture: two children running among garden plants]. 18th: but this afternoon, they ... [the two children swimming in water]. Complete the contrast.
questions.answer: They usually play in the garden in the afternoon, but this afternoon, they are swimming in the river.

questions.prompt: 19th: I usually cook a meal in the evening, [picture: a person attending to a stove]. 20th: but this evening, I ... [the person reclining and reading a book]. Complete the contrast.
questions.answer: I usually cook a meal in the evening, but this evening, I am reading a book.

questions.prompt: 21st: We usually watch television at night, [picture: a family seated facing a television]. 22nd: but tonight, we ... [the family seated facing a stereo]. Complete the contrast.
questions.answer: We usually watch television at night, but tonight, we are listening to the stereo.

lesson.title: Written exercises A
lesson.translation: 模仿例句完成以下句子。

questions.prompt: He usually shaves at 7.00 o'clock, but today, he ______ at 8.00.
questions.answer: He usually shaves at 7.00 o'clock, but today, he is shaving at 8.00.

questions.prompt: She usually drinks tea in the morning, but this morning, she ______ coffee.
questions.answer: She usually drinks tea in the morning, but this morning, she is drinking coffee.

questions.prompt: They usually play in the garden in the afternoon, but this afternoon, they ______ in the park.
questions.answer: They usually play in the garden in the afternoon, but this afternoon, they are playing in the park.

questions.prompt: He usually washes the dishes at night, but tonight he ______ clothes.
questions.answer: He usually washes the dishes at night, but tonight he is washing clothes.

lesson.title: Written exercises B
lesson.instruction: Write questions and answers following the pattern in the example. Use each numbered pair of usual and current activities.
lesson.translation: 模仿例句提问并回答。每题分别写出通常的活动和今天正在进行的活动。
lesson.context: Examples: they/every day — go/to school by car; today — go/to school on foot.

questions.prompt: they/every day — go/to school by car
questions.answer:
What do they usually do every day?
They usually go to school by car every day.

questions.prompt: today — go/to school on foot
questions.answer:
What are they doing today?
They are going to school on foot today.

questions.prompt: she/morning — drink/tea; morning — drink/coffee. Write both questions and answers.
questions.answer:
What does she usually do in the morning?
She usually drinks tea in the morning.
What is she doing this morning?
She is drinking coffee this morning.

questions.prompt: they/afternoon — play/in the garden; afternoon — swim/in the river. Write both questions and answers.
questions.answer:
What do they usually do in the afternoon?
They usually play in the garden in the afternoon.
What are they doing this afternoon?
They are swimming in the river this afternoon.

questions.prompt: I/evening — cook/a meal; evening — read/a book. Write both questions and answers.
questions.answer:
What do you usually do in the evening?
I usually cook a meal in the evening.
What are you doing this evening?
I am reading a book this evening.

questions.prompt: we/night — watch/television; tonight — listen to/the stereo. Write both questions and answers.
questions.answer:
What do you usually do at night?
We usually watch television at night.
What are you doing tonight?
We are listening to the stereo tonight.

practice.title: A. What do they usually do? What are they doing today?
practice.instruction: Look at the table. Now write questions and answers like the example.
practice.translation: 请看下表。模仿例句提问并回答。
practice.context: Printed statements above the exercise: He usually walks to work in the morning, but today he's going by car. She usually drinks tea in the afternoon, but this afternoon she's making the beds. Table rows: 1 she / cook a meal? / evening; do / this evening? / read an interesting book. 2 he / drive to work? / morning; do / this morning? / walk to work. 3 they / go to school? / afternoon; do / this afternoon? / stay at home. 4 you / watch television? / at night; do / tonight? / listen to the radio.

questions.prompt: she / cook a meal?; evening; do / this evening?; read an interesting book
questions.answer:
When does she usually cook a meal?
She usually cooks a meal in the evening.
What's she doing this evening? Is she cooking a meal?
No, she isn't. She's reading an interesting book.

questions.prompt: he / drive to work?; morning; do / this morning?; walk to work. Write questions and answers as in the example.
questions.answer:
When does he usually drive to work?
He usually drives to work in the morning.
What's he doing this morning? Is he driving to work?
No, he isn't. He's walking to work.

questions.prompt: they / go to school?; afternoon; do / this afternoon?; stay at home. Write questions and answers as in the example.
questions.answer:
When do they usually go to school?
They usually go to school in the afternoon.
What are they doing this afternoon? Are they going to school?
No, they aren't. They're staying at home.

questions.prompt: you / watch television?; at night; do / tonight?; listen to the radio. Write questions and answers as in the example.
questions.answer:
When do you usually watch television?
I / We usually watch television at night.
What are you doing tonight? Are you watching television?
No, I'm not / we aren't. I'm / We're listening to the radio.

practice.title: B. Situations
practice.instruction: Read the situations. What do you say?
practice.translation: 按照以下情景写出你应该说的话。

questions.prompt: You want to know the time. You ask an English person.
questions.answer: What's the time, please?

questions.prompt: You are talking to a visitor to China. You want to know his / her nationality.
questions.answer: Where do you come from?

questions.prompt: You are talking to an English speaker. You want to know his / her address.
questions.answer: Where do you live?

grammar.title: I. Answer the questions: 1
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the examples.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=177
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=489

questions.prompt: What are you doing now? (read a newspaper)
questions.answer: I'm reading a newspaper.

questions.prompt: Do you read a newspaper every day? (often)
questions.answer: No, I don't read a newspaper every day, but I often read a newspaper.

questions.prompt: What are you doing now? (write a letter to my mother)
questions.answer: I'm writing a letter to my mother.

questions.prompt: Do you write home every week? (sometimes)
questions.answer: No, I don't write home every week, but I sometimes write home.

questions.prompt: What is she doing now? (clean her shoes)
questions.answer: She's cleaning her shoes.

questions.prompt: Does she clean her shoes every day? (every week)
questions.answer: No, she doesn't clean her shoes every day, but she cleans her shoes every week.

questions.prompt: What is your sister doing now? (sweep the floor)
questions.answer: She's sweeping the floor.

questions.prompt: Does she often sweep the floor? (sometimes)
questions.answer: No, she doesn't often sweep the floor, but she sometimes sweeps it.

questions.prompt: What are the students doing now? (watch television)
questions.answer: They're watching television.

questions.prompt: Do they always watch television at night? (sometimes)
questions.answer: No, they don't always watch television at night, but they sometimes watch it at night.

grammar.title: I. Answer the questions: 2
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the examples.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=178
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=489

questions.prompt: What is the postman doing now? (deliver letters)
questions.answer: He is delivering letters.

questions.prompt: Does he often deliver letters at eight o'clock in the morning? (often at eight thirty)
questions.answer: No, he doesn't. He often delivers letters at eight thirty in the morning.

questions.prompt: What is your husband doing now? (take our son to school)
questions.answer: He is taking our son to school.

questions.prompt: Does he take your son to school at this time every morning? (usually at seven)
questions.answer: No, he doesn't. He usually takes him to school at seven.

questions.prompt: What are you doing now? (wait for a bus)
questions.answer: I am waiting for a bus.

questions.prompt: Do you usually wait for a bus at eight o'clock? (usually at seven thirty)
questions.answer: No, I don't. I usually wait for a bus at seven thirty.

questions.prompt: What are the children doing now? (do their homework)
questions.answer: They are doing their homework.

questions.prompt: Do they always do their homework in the afternoon? (usually in the evening)
questions.answer: No, they don't. They usually do their homework in the evening.

questions.prompt: What is the keyboard operator doing now? (type letters)
questions.answer: He is typing letters.

questions.prompt: Does he often type letters at noon? (usually at nine in the morning)
questions.answer: No, he doesn't. He usually types letters at nine in the morning.

grammar.title: II. What's the time?
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the examples.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=179
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=489

questions.prompt: six/our friends/come and see us. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's six o'clock. Our friends usually come and see us at six.

questions.prompt: two/we/go to work. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's two o'clock. We usually go to work at two.

questions.prompt: five/you/cook a meal. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's five o'clock. You usually cook a meal at five.

questions.prompt: four/the children/come home from school. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's four o'clock. The children usually come home from school at four.

questions.prompt: ten/she/go to bed. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's ten o'clock. She usually goes to bed at ten.

questions.prompt: eight/I/do my homework. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's eight o'clock. I usually do my homework at eight.

questions.prompt: nine/he/read a newspaper. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's nine o'clock. He usually reads a newspaper at nine.

questions.prompt: eleven/I/go to the shops. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's eleven o'clock. I usually go to the shops at eleven.

questions.prompt: one/she/cook a meal. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's one o'clock. She usually cooks a meal at one.

questions.prompt: four/we/drink tea. What's the time?
questions.answer: It's four o'clock. We usually drink tea at four.
